limitations: Four consumed and deliberately sampled development seed clusters, not an independent holdout or significance claim.
The early head did not train on these registered clusters, but some states were generated with it; the merged head used the archives for training and per-group historical batch exposure is unknown.
Conditional same-target ranking does not establish full actions, successful planting, profit or causal effects.

On the selected PLANT groups only, the full-candidate guard means both A-minus-B differences are at least -5 percentage points, not that either is positive; other teacher-operation groups are not evaluated.
Exact qualifying-group and per-cluster counts, source values and logits are not published; coarse projections do not guarantee formal anonymity.
NumPy scorer and archive reader were reused in the independent recomputation; model hashing and loading are separate reads without an OS lock.
Only the runner and independent review report their own operations; no system-wide GPU or file access monitoring was performed.
